name: Barnyard Millet Instant Noodles
short_description: Traditional grain. Everyday goodness.
description: Bring the goodness of Kuthiraivali into a familiar favourite. Made with barnyard millet, these noodles offer a convenient way to explore traditional grains in everyday meals.
